newsitem.title: UK: BOE gives UK money market 215 mln stg further help.
newsitem.headline: BOE gives UK money market 215 mln stg further help.

text.p: The Bank of England said it provided the UK money market with a further 215 million stg of assistance at established interest rates.
The Bank allotted 15 million stg in outright bills maturing on or before May 1 and 200 million stg in repos to April 29 and May 1, in operations at 1110 GMT.
Earlier, the Bank provided 470 million in assistance. With a money market shortage forecast at 1.25 billion stg, 565 million stg remains outstanding.
